items.title: 68089_John Malachi oral history interview
items.q: the first piece they passed out was a piece called .. It was a dance number, and it was a piece written by Don Redman that they used as a theme song.

ctx.x: So I went down there, and it happened that I knew a few of the guys in that band, because they also used to come up and jam with me, up at this place -- at the Atlantic Beer Garden. So I went in, they all welcomed me and everything. And the leader... I don't remember who he was or what his name was, but he was one of the guys. So they said, "Rehearsals will start in about a half-hour, and as soon as all the principals get here..." There were these girls -- I've forgotten how many of them there were. As a matter…

So when the time came for rehearsal, the first piece they passed out was a piece called .. It was a dance number, and it was a piece written by Don Redman that they used as a theme song.
